construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: SYNTHETIC product catalog JSON feed, query, limit, timezone-aware as_of, synthetic customer profile with boolean GDPR/CCPA consent, basket, clickstream click/purchase event log, personalization switch, research allowlist and inline captured documents
shared_schema.output: One status/schema_version/fixture_label/input_digest/stage/query/customer_id/basket_id/personalization_mode/items envelope shared by all stages
shared_schema.item: Catalog SKU/name/category/price/currency/stock plus semantic_score, behavior_score, total score and provenance-preserving findings
shared_schema.validation: Strict known fields, finite numeric values, exact catalog snapshots, referential integrity, timestamp ordering, consent, exact URL host allowlist and source-quote/hash matching; input fingerprint binds handoffs to the same request
shared_schema.errors: CLI emits a single JSON object with status error and exits 2 for validation, parsing and file errors

cross_stage_handoffs: semantic -> behavior: validated semantic envelope supplies bounded candidate SKUs and relevance scores; behavior retains membership and adds consented recency/profile/basket boosts
behavior -> web: validated behavior envelope supplies ranked candidate SKUs and scores; offline retrieval preserves ranking and commercial fields while attaching exact SKU-scoped source quotations

behavior.semantic: Builds an inverted token index; lexical score is query-term coverage. Optional injected callable receives query plus SKU-sorted product texts and returns validated finite nonzero equal-width numeric vectors. Positive cosine similarity adds to relevance; score/SKU tie breaking is deterministic.
behavior.personalization: Requires both GDPR and CCPA consent when enabled. Purchase weight 3 and click weight 1 decay with a 30-day half-life relative to as_of; basket quantity contributes 0.5 each; other same-category history contributes 0.25 of its weight; declared category interest adds 0.2. Disabled mode ignores history, basket and interests. Cold-start uses declared interests or unchanged semantic ranking.
behavior.research: No HTTP calls. Caller supplies synthetic captured URL documents. HTTPS exact-host allowlisting rejects credentials, nonstandard ports, fragments and malformed hosts. Retrieve only query-relevant documents for ranked product SKUs, bounded per product, preserving exact title/text/capture time and SHA-256 content hash.
behavior.retail_constraints: Price/currency/stock copied only from catalog. Out-of-stock products remain visible with stock zero; basket quantities must fit catalog stock. Synthetic research excludes reviews/endorsements and commercial claims through restrictive schema and demonstrative keyword checks.
behavior.synthetic_fixtures: All SKUs, prices, stock, shopper identities, events and specifications are invented; reserved example.test source hosts are never contacted.

included: Offline allowlisted URL ingestion and retrieval
